**Settings and five languages.** Both apps now have **Settings…** under About AirGlass (⌘, on macOS, Ctrl+, on Windows, and in the Windows tray menu). It opens a small window with a **Language** choice: English, Türkçe, 中文（普通话）, हिन्दी, Español. The interface switches right away and remembers the choice. Until you pick one, AirGlass starts in your system language, or in English if your system language isn't one of these. The page on the phone follows the phone's own language.

- **Windows:** download and run `AirGlass-0.3.0.exe`; no installer and no .NET needed. Requires Windows 10 (2004) or Windows 11. The exe is not signed, so choose **More info → Run anyway** in SmartScreen, and allow **Private networks** when the firewall asks. Details in the [README](https://github.com/lupusoftco/airglass#windows).
- **macOS:** open `AirGlass-0.3.0.dmg` and drag AirGlass into Applications. Requires macOS 14 or later. The app is not notarized: see the ["Open Anyway" steps in the README](https://github.com/lupusoftco/airglass#installation) for the first launch.
